skill.name: obsidian-helper
skill.description: AI assistant workflow for Obsidian that creates daily notes, captures ideas, and generates periodic reviews through Obsidian MCP.
skill.summary: Create daily notes, capture ideas, and review Obsidian work with append-only MCP workflows.
skill.author: Claude Code

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, local Obsidian setup instructions, and multilingual documentation. I found no evidence of autonomous command execution, remote exfiltration, hardcoded secrets, obfuscation, or prompt-injection content in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Setup instructions modify Claude MCP configuration.
remediation.suggestion: State that users should run setup commands themselves and review mcp.json before saving changes.

remediation.issue: The workflow reads personal Obsidian notes through MCP.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short privacy note explaining that daily and review features process vault contents.

remediation.issue: The README uses a placeholder GitHub clone URL.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the placeholder repository URL with the canonical source URL to reduce installation confusion.

content.value_statement: Obsidian vaults can become hard to review and update consistently. This skill helps Claude and Codex create daily notes, capture ideas, and summarize recent work.
actual_capabilities: Detects Obsidian MCP connection and explains Local REST API setup.
Creates or updates daily notes with a structured template.
Carries unfinished tasks from yesterday into today when daily notes are available.
Captures ideas by searching related notes and appending to a selected target.
Generates daily, weekly, or monthly review notes from periodic notes and recent changes.
Applies a PARA and Zettelkasten vault structure with a property whitelist.
limitations: Requires Obsidian, Local REST API, and mcp-obsidian for vault operations.
Can only read and write through available Obsidian MCP tools.
Review quality depends on note structure, task formatting, and search results.
Users should confirm target notes before content is appended or moved.

use_cases.title: Start a Daily Planning Note
use_cases.description: Create today's note, carry forward unfinished tasks, and prepare focus sections for the day.

use_cases.title: Capture Research Ideas
use_cases.description: Search related notes before saving a new idea, then append it to the best confirmed location.

use_cases.title: Generate Weekly Reviews
use_cases.description: Summarize tasks, active notes, themes, and next priorities from recent Obsidian activity.

prompt_templates.title: Start Today's Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Use obsidian-helper to start my daily note. Carry over unfinished tasks from yesterday and ask before adding new sections.

prompt_templates.title: Capture a Quick Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Capture this idea in Obsidian: [topic and note]. Search for related notes first, then ask where to save it.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Weekly Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a weekly review from my daily notes. Summarize completed tasks, unresolved items, themes, and next-week priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Vault Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Obsidian vault structure against the skill guidance. Suggest append-only improvements and property fields to standardize.

output_examples.output: Daily note created for 2026-07-08. It carried over open tasks and prepared focus, notes, and reflection sections.

output_examples.input: Capture a note about REST API naming.
output: Found an API design note as a likely match.
Appended the captured idea with a timestamp.

output_examples.output: Weekly review created with task counts, active files, key themes, achievements, and next-week priorities.

best_practices: Confirm the MCP connection and target vault before writing notes.
Use append or patch operations so existing notes are not overwritten.
Keep note properties within the documented whitelist.
anti_patterns: Asking the skill to rewrite entire notes without reviewing changes.
Saving generated content outside the AI inbox without explicit user choice.
Pasting private API keys into chat instead of local configuration files.

faq.question: Does this work without Obsidian MCP?
faq.answer: It can explain setup steps, but vault reads and writes require a working Obsidian MCP connection.

faq.question: Will it overwrite my notes?
faq.answer: The workflow instructs append or patch operations. Users should still review target files before approving writes.

faq.question: Does it send notes to external services?
faq.answer: The skill targets local Obsidian MCP tools and a localhost endpoint. It does not specify remote uploads.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can I customize folders and templates?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill describes an Obsidian configuration note and template files for daily and review workflows.

faq.question: Is it only for Chinese notes?
faq.answer: The source documentation is Chinese-first, but the workflows can be used with English or Chinese prompts.
